behavior: Measure the string using the selected native font, store the nonnegative half-width offset in 0x00E20770, then draw through 0x004CC770 at x plus that offset.
verification: Live Ghidra decompilation and 32-site caller graph were checked against the pinned executable. The implementation reuses the mapped typed 0x004CBF30 and 0x004CC770 C owners and the old project's centered-text algorithm; it preserves the native offset-global write.
